title: Expose Teacher attendance entry from the lesson day
verify: Teacher lesson-day flow reads the authorized class student list, marks the submitted absent subset, and persists every unmarked student as present.
Learning Progress owns the batch attendance command and attendance/charge semantics; Lesson Context remains a thin adapter.

T3 proof covers individual and group classes, assigned Teacher success, anonymous/unassigned/cross-center denial, forged scope fields, state-before/state-after on failure, and no direct financial or scheduling writes.

evidence: Distinct two-center individual/group fixture proved absent-subset/default-present persistence, assigned Teacher success, denial/no-mutation for missing, unassigned, cross-center, and forged scope, and Student route denial.

verify.attempt: Independent adversarial boundary and ownership review
evidence: No material authority, privacy, persistence, ownership, source-of-truth, or accepted-outcome break was found across supported individual/group, authorization, forged-scope, and route-adapter paths.
No operator question was required; lifecycle_changed is false.

verify.accepted_evidence: Functional PASS, semantic-pass, executor RED/GREEN, fresh verifier probe, and project gates are recorded in the linked artifacts.

evidence_required: FT-005-AC-005 / REQ-010 / REQ-014 RED: no lesson-day attendance list exists, unmarked students are not persisted as present, or an unauthorized Teacher can submit; GREEN: an assigned Teacher in both individual and group classes saves the absent subset and default-present remainder through Learning Progress, while unauthorized/cross-center submissions fail before mutation; artifact: .tasks/TASK-042-T3-FT-005-W22/ and .protocols/TASK-042-T3-FT-005-W22/.
purpose: Provide the protected lesson-day attendance entry required by FT-005-AC-005.
success_outcome: An assigned Teacher opens an authorized lesson day, marks absent students, and saves one atomic attendance result where every unmarked class student is present; attendance remains the source for existing charge eligibility and correction.
anti_goals: Do not let the route write learning or financial tables directly.
Do not add a third attendance state or change charge/reconciliation ownership.
Do not add Admin payment/schedule behavior, student/parent attendance editing, or a new route.
constraints: Learning Progress owns the batch attendance command and may call Financial Ledger only through Attendance Charge Reconciliation.
The server resolves actor, class, lesson, assignment, and student scope; submitted IDs cannot widen it.
The lesson-context route adapts the form only; it does not own attendance semantics or direct persistence.
invariants: Only an assigned Teacher can affect the target class lesson through this visible flow.
IDs marked absent are absent and every other student in the authorized class is present after a successful save.
Failed or unauthorized submission leaves attendance and financial state unchanged.
Attendance uses only present/absent and remains the source for existing charge eligibility/correction.
verification_targets: FT-005-AC-005: fresh browser/HTTP or route-boundary probe for an assigned Teacher in individual and group classes; list all authorized students, submit an absent subset, and assert persisted absent/present rows.
Authorization: anonymous, unassigned Teacher, cross-center Teacher, and forged student/lesson/class fields fail before mutation with state-before/state-after equality.

Ownership: source/runtime probe confirms the route calls the Learning Progress public command, no route direct learning/financial/scheduling table access exists, and existing TASK-010 charge/reconciliation behavior remains green.
Run npm run check, npm run build, npm run test, focused attendance/lesson-context tests, and diff hygiene.

stop_conditions: Stop if the attendance-list command requires a new module, event bus, persistence owner, or accepted cross-slice edge.
Stop if the route would need direct database writes or client-owned authorization.
Stop if the existing present/absent or Financial Ledger reconciliation contract must change.
